run_svm_test: run the SVM test module to evaluate trained models on image classification data
test_svm_models: test trained SVM models per class using chosen costs and compute mean AP
get_chosen_costs: get the SVM cost per class that maximizes cross-validation average precision
load_json_targets: load a JSON file of image targets and extract image IDs and class names
generate_svm_predictions_json: generate a JSON file of SVM predictions for each image and class
